Other routing, retrieval, and answer-selection benchmarks can suggest methods
because they share task structure. Their candidate pools, judgments, splits,
and metrics differ.

## Why this matters for 2026

Task similarity can motivate a test design.

## What this does not prove

External scores are not imported into the TREC development leaderboard and are
not evidence of direct superiority here. See the
[`source notes`](../../../reports/trec_2026_approaches_guide_source_notes.md).
